entry.title: Odinstårnet
entry.note: The model follows the published 177 m height and the two public decks at 70 and 140 m above the original ground. The exact section sizes, paint color, glazing, furnishings and terrace detail are inferred from period photos. The full-sized tower is centered at the mapped memorial on Bolbro Bakke. Its signed facing follows the period view from the south and the nearby Middelfartvej alignment. Foundation corners and the dining terrace are approximate. The viewer shows the reconstruction for an explicit date during the tower’s lifetime. Native terrain, current streets and surrounding buildings provide the site context. Historical placement requires an explicit viewingDate within the recorded appearance interval; excluded from the default current world.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
